product.title: Mauna Kea Summit Tour with Free Night Star Photo

description.text: From Kona-side departures, travel to the 13,803-foot peak of Mauna Kea—Hawaii's highest point and a popular spot for star-gazing. Stop for dinner at the Onizuka Astronomy Complex, then arrive at the summit in time to watch the sunset. Stops include Kailua-Kona, Onizuka Astronomy Complex, Mauna Kea Summit, Night Star Photo Session. As dark sets in, enjoy a stargazing session and receive a complimentary night star photo to take home. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
